description: This file contains functions for parsing and rendering Markdown content, including handling headers, code blocks, notes, and nested structures. It exports functions for parsing Markdown text into a node tree, rendering nodes back to Markdown, cloning nodes, visiting nodes, and filtering nodes by language.

methods.name: flattenWrappedLines
methods.description: Flattens wrapped lines in Markdown content, handling code blocks and special syntax.

methods.name: buildTree
methods.description: Builds a Markdown node tree from an array of lines, recognizing headers, code blocks, notes, properties, and list items.

methods.name: parseCodeBlockMetadata
methods.description: Parses metadata from code block start lines, extracting language, title, and highlight info.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main function to parse Markdown content into a node tree.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders a node tree back into Markdown text with optional formatting options.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Deep clones a Markdown node and its children.

methods.name: visitAll
methods.description: Visits all nodes in a node tree with a visitor function.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Recursively visits a node and its children with a visitor function.

methods.name: filterNodesForLanguage
methods.description: Filters nodes to include only those matching a specified language in 'langs:' list.

methods.name: wrapText
methods.description: Wraps text to a specified maximum column width, with optional flattening.
